groups.name: hooks
groups._comment: `find -name '*.mjs'` matches dotfiles, so .prettierrc.mjs was shipping as a hook. It configures this repo's own hook toolchain (see .claude/hooks/package.json, which is NOT deployed), so in a target project it is an orphan no prettier ever reads.

groups.name: hook-infra
groups._comment: core/*.ts carries graph-policy.ts, which hooks import at runtime. A value import must deploy or every target crashes on load. Tests are excluded: they are toolchain files, not hooks.

groups.name: agents
groups._comment: Claude Code agent frontmatter is name/description/model/tools — no version: field, so compare by checksum rather than frontmatter.

groups.name: editorconfig
groups._comment: Editor settings are universal, unlike the rest of scaffold/ which is project-shape-specific (compose files, hydra, CI). So this one file deploys unconditionally instead of waiting for --group scaffold. no-clobber: a project that already has an .editorconfig keeps it.
